But here are some diseases for which cure is not available in modern science. Sarcoidosis is one of them. Yes, sarcoidosis is an auto-immune disease that usually affects the lungs, eyes, lymph nodes and skin. With the help of Ayurveda, this disorder can be very well managed. Yes, we are going to give you a brief description of an Ayurvedic treatment of sarcoidosis in this article. But first discuss the little about the disorder and its symptoms. 
 About Sarcoidosis 

 In simple language, we can define it as the growth of tiny collections of inflammatory cells in several parts of the body. Inflammation in the affected organ is the common symptom. It can affect any organ of the body but mostly it is found to affect lungs, eyes, skin and lymph nodes. A disturbed immune system is believed to be the reason behind this health problem. The disorder usually affects the adults of age 20 to 40 years and is more common in women as compared to men. The exact cause for the same is still not known.

 Skin – Red colored patches on the skin, growth under skin and lesions on the nose are some of the common symptoms.

Due to this, antibodies accumulate in several organs of the body in the form of inflammatory lumps. After knowing the cause, disorder can be well managed.
